name: ATLAS CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, genspark_ai_developer]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  quality:
    name: Quality gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: "npm"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Prettier
        run: npm run format:check

      - name: i18n consistency
        run: npm run check:i18n

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build
